home.principal_desc1: Vocational education is the key to unlocking a bright future. At SMK PGRI 3 Malang, we equip students not only with cutting-edge technical skills, but also shape character, discipline, and a winning mindset.
home.principal_desc2: Supported by industry-standard facilities and professional educators, we are committed to aligning our curriculum with Business & Industry (DUDI) needs, ensuring every graduate is ready to work, pursue higher education, or innovate as an entrepreneur.
home.why_desc: Combining practical expertise and strong character building to shape career-ready graduates.
home.card_akreditasi_desc: Recognized with top accreditation scores, guaranteeing national-standard education quality and superior facilities.
home.card_kurikulum_desc: Learning is directly aligned with partner industries, utilizing real-world equipment and standard operating procedures.
home.card_bki_desc: Dedicated career placement for graduates through an extensive network of national and multinational corporate partners.
home.card_ahli_desc: Guided directly by certified industry practitioners and experienced vocational teachers.
home.departments_desc: Explore 4 departments with 15 specialized concentrations designed to help you compete in today’s industry.
home.partners_desc: Partnering with leading companies to deliver industry-based learning and open up broad career paths.

footer.tagline: Leading Vocational High School in Malang City preparing competent and work-ready graduates across industry sectors.
